He played two seasons of [[college basketball]] for the [[Rhode Island Rams men's basketball|Rhode Island Rams]]. ==High school career== Munford attended [[Saint Benedict's Preparatory School]] in [[Newark, New Jersey]]. As a senior in 2009–10, he helped the Grey Bees to a 26–1 record and the No. 2 national ranking, while averaging 12 points per game.{{cite web|title=Xavier Munford – Rhode Island|url=http://www.gorhody.com/sports/m-baskbl/2013-14/bios/munford_xavier_jvgs?view=bio|work=GoRhody.com|access-date=August 8, 2016|archive-date=February 15, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160215155230/http://www.gorhody.com/sports/m-baskbl/2013-14/bios/munford_xavier_jvgs?view=bio|url-status=dead}} ==College career== As a freshman at [[Miami Dade College]] in 2010–11, Munford averaged 17.3 points, 2.8 rebounds, 2.4 assists and 1.5 steals in 32 games. He was subsequently named the FCSAA's Newcomer of the Year and was a First Team All-NJCAA Region 8 selection. In 2011, Munford transferred to [[Iowa Western Community College]], where as a sophomore in 2011–12, he averaged 16.6 points per game for the Reivers, leading the Iowa Community College Athletic Conference (ICCAC). He helped guide Iowa Western to a 24–9 record en route to the NJCAA Region 11 finals, and was a 2011–12 NJCAA Division I All-American selection. Following the 2011–12 season, Munford signed a [[National Letter of Intent]] to play [[college basketball]] for the [[Rhode Island Rams men's basketball|University of Rhode Island]].{{cite web|title=Reiver Shooting Guard Signs NCAA D1|url=http://www.goreivers.com/sports/news.asp?Sport=basketball_m&Num=942|work=GoReivers.com|access-date=August 8, 2016|archive-date=August 21, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160821095345/http://www.goreivers.com/sports/news.asp?Sport=basketball_m&Num=942|url-status=dead}} As a junior playing for the Rhode Island Rams in 2012–13, Munford was named to the USBWA All-District I team. In 29 games, he averaged 17.4 points (ranked third in the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]), 2.8 rebounds, 1.9 assists and 1.0 steals in 35.4 minutes per game.{{cite web|title=Xavier Munford Stats|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/players/xavier-munford-1.html|work=Sports-Reference.com|access-date=August 8, 2016}} As a senior in 2013–14, Munford became the fastest player in school history to reach the 1,000-point plateau, getting there in his final home game for the Rams against Fordham.{{cite web|first=Brendan|last=Prunty|url=http://www.nj.com/college-basketball/index.ssf/2014/03/ncaa_court_vision_rhode_island_and_xavier_munford_became_perfect_fit_at_the_right_time.html|title=NCAA Court Vision: Rhode Island and Xavier Munford became perfect fit at the right time|work=NJ.com|date=March 10, 2014|access-date=January 29, 2016}}{{cite web|first=Kevin|last=McNamara|url=http://www.providencejournal.com/article/20141101/sports/311019947|title=Erik Murphy, Xavier Munford go in NBDL Draft|work=ProvidenceJournal.com|date=November 1, 2014|access-date=January 29, 2016}} In 32 games, he averaged 16.9 points, 4.0 rebounds, 2.4 assists and 1.1 steals in 35.6 minutes per game. ==Professional career== ===Bakersfield Jam (2014–2016)=== Munford went undrafted in the [[2014 NBA draft]]. On November 1, 2014, Munford was selected by the [[Maine Red Claws]] in the third round of the [[2014 NBA Development League Draft]]. He was later traded to the [[Northern Arizona Suns|Bakersfield Jam]] on draft night.{{cite web|url=http://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/bakersfield-jam-select-six-players-in-2014-nba-d-league-draft/n-4889972|title=Bakersfield Jam Select Six Players in 2014 NBA D-League Draft|work=OurSportsCentral.com|date=November 1, 2014|access-date=January 29, 2016}} On November 14, he made his professional debut in a 127–125 loss to the [[Texas Legends]], recording seven points, two rebounds, two assists and one steal in 10 minutes.{{cite web|url=http://dleague.nba.com/games/20141114/TEXBAK/|title=Suns Assignee T.J. Warren Erupts For 40 Points in Loss on Friday|work=NBA.com|date=November 14, 2014|access-date=January 29, 2016|archive-date=February 4, 3.4 rebounds, 2.8 assists and 1.0 steals per game.{{cite web|first=Chris|last=Reichert|url=http://upsidemotor.com/2015/10/27/xavier-munford-rhode-island-d-league-nba-bakersfield-jam/|title=Xavier
